scope.native: Only ordinary !page/!mask/!sinks F32 Dq=Dv192, Q>8, causal Q<=KV or noncausal. Existing D256 guard literal and NAX early-return unchanged. One tile BQ16/BK8/WM2/WN1, plain float QueryT, hyle_q8=false.
scope.hyle: GPU ordinary F32 D192 none-mask full attention on known Apple architecture generations13-16, nonempty B/KV. Reuses existing known_gpu_without_nax() cold capability query; unknown/new architectures retain current routes.
scope.precision: Original float Steel loads, QK, online softmax probabilities and PV; no half/TF32/new kernel.
scope.unchanged: D256, page/ragged/q8/half branches, CPU streams, explicit masks/fully-masked bool semantics, causal Q>KV/decode fallback; public C++ API/ABI.

threadgroup.admission: Actual staticThreadgroupMemoryLength checked before encoder dispatch; only selected tile was tested, no fallback tile trial.

F32 BSHD GQA Q33/KV17 noncausal negative-0.25 scale, nonzero QK, unaligned tails

correctness.oracle: Existing independent FP64 test helper; F32 rel6e-6+abs2e-6 unchanged. Same exact test TU linked both arms.

space.input: Pre-fixed Q/K0, V alternating +1.25/-1.25 by KV row; original FP64 prefix-mean oracle and rel6e-6+abs2e-6 over all99,072 outputs. No post-result input or budget change.
space.metric: MLX allocator peak minus active-before-submit, after public prepare/create_invocation/bind and clear_cache/reset_peak; submit/wait/synchronize included, output396288B retained. Cold preparation/JIT excluded; not whole-device VRAM or RSS.
space.executions: Exactly one fresh baseline and one fresh candidate process, no timing or repeat matrix.

build.scope: Two native selector overlays, two Hyle lowerers, one three-case test TU, one fixed space TU. Original current resource native host baseline freshly compiled so existing D256 patch is retained on both sides.
build.failures: No remote compile/link/runtime failures. Two initial local preparation attempts failed exact source-hash path/test-name lookup before any remote build; corrected to current materializer-output source and actual full test name.
build.identity: measured/runtime-identities.json includes all reused SDK/gtest library hashes and temporary object/executable identities. No SDK/metallib rebuild, configure, download or copy.

limitations: Only this Air M4 and one tile were tested. No throughput claim or speed ranking.

D192 long-Q uniform case was not run; prior D256 result is not evidence for D192 numerical behavior.
